# dsh-search-picker
**English** | 中文

A **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** bundle plugin that puts a “Search: …” button at the
bottom of the deskt

op sidebar (right above the Settings row) and switches
`ctx.web`'s search backend with one click.

The picker writes the official `web` settings namespace's `searchProvider`
field — the exact same fi

eld edited by **Plugins › Web search** in the DSH
settings UI. Therefore:

- switches take effect immediately, no restart;
- the choice survives restarts (persisted in the hos

t settings document);
- it never fights the official settings page — both edit the same field.
## Engines
| id | Engine | Credential | Notes |
| `deepseek-official` | DeepSeek official Messages | `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` | Built in. Anthropic Messag

es + `web_search_20250305`; each search consumes model tokens |
| `deepseek-search-api` | DeepSeek o

fficial Search API | `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` | Built in. Direct retrieval endpoint; no model tokens |
| `
opencode-go` | OpenCode Go | `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY` | Provided by this plugin. Anthropic Messages + `

x-opencode-session` header; ≈ $0.01 per search |
| `tavily` | Tavily | `TAVILY_API_KEY` | Provided b

y this plugin; greyed out until a key is configured |
| `exa` | Exa | `EXA_API_KEY` | Provided by th
is plugin; greyed out until a key is configured |

Engines without credentials are greyed out in the menu. Selecting an
unregistered/unavailable provid

er directly in the settings page makes
`web_search` return an explicit `WEB_PROVIDER_*` error instea

d of silently
falling back to another engine.
## UI

The button sits at the bottom of the sidebar, right above the Settings row. The
menu is a `position:

fixed` popover: its width follows the sidebar content width
(sidebar defaults to 280 px, draggable

264–420 px → menu 240–396 px) and updates
live while dragging, so it is never clipped by the sidebar

column's
`overflow: hidden`. When the sidebar collapses to the 56 px icon rail, the menu
pops out a
t 280 px to the right.

The menu background is opaque: white in the light theme, dark grey in the dark
theme (`--dsw-alias-b

g-layer-1`, theme-aware), with the official popover
hairline stroke and soft elevation shadow (`--ds

w-elevation-panel`). The
official menu material (`--dsw-specific-menu` + `backdrop-filter` blur) is

intentionally not used: that surface is only 58 % opaque and relies on the blur
to look right, so wi
thout the blur the sidebar text bleeds through.

3. In `%DSH_HOME%\profiles\desktop`, run `pnpm install`.
4. F

ully quit and reopen the DSH desktop app. The loader scans profile bundles
only at startup, and the

client half is read into memory at startup too — so
a page refresh is not enough after updating the

If the `file:` dependency fails to resolve, copy this directory into

de_modules\dsh-search-picker` and add the package
name to `dsh.profile.bundles` instead.
## Configuration

The bundle ships a default patch entry (`cordis.patch.yml`). Every field is
optional; omitted fields
fall back to the defaults below.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Override any value by targeting the same entry id from your profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`.
## Credentials

This plugin never reads or writes the credentials file directly. At search time
it resolves the cred

ential reference named by `apiKeyEnv` through
`ctx.credentials`, falling back to the process environ

ment. A missing credential
raises `WEB_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_MISSING`, and the message names the refer

credential
raises `WEB_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_MISSING`, and the message names the referenced
variable.
## Fallback

1. Switch back to `deepseek-official` in the menu (or use the official
**Plugins › Web search** page
bundles`, run `pnpm install`, restart the desktop app.
## Troubleshooting

- **`deepseek-official` returns 404**: check that neither the profile patch nor
another plugin overr

ides `web-search-deepseek.baseURL`. It must stay on the
built-in default (`https://api.deepseek.com/

anthropic/v1`); pointing it at a
search provider's host breaks the provider.
- **Menu width does not

follow the sidebar**: the popover measures its anchor
with `ResizeObserver`; after profile/bundle c

hanges, restart the desktop app
to reload the client bundle.
## Testing

The single-process fallback exists for Windows sandboxes that block
child-process pipes (`spawn EPER

single-process fallback exists for Windows sandboxes that block
child-process pipes (`spawn EPERM`).
## Known limitations

- The engine list in the menu is fixed. If the official providers' `apiKeyEnv`
is remapped to anothe

r credential name, the greyed-out state still checks the
default reference name.
- Conflicts with pl

ugins that take over `web.searchProvider` at runtime
(`dsh-free-search`, `dsh-web-search-free`, …).

Do not install them together.
- `opencode-go`'s `x-opencode-session` uses a random in-process UUID w

hen the
current session id is unavailable (the Go relay only needs it to be opaque and
stable).
## Compatibility

- DSH desktop `0.2.1-rc.2` (declared in `package.json` → `dsh.compatibility`).
- Client half targets

the `web` platform and injects
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-remotes`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale`,
`@
deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings`.
